paper: How Short-Term Thought Is Required for Long-Term Memory: a Mind's Eye implemented to combat aphasia, aphantasia, and amnesia in context-prompt models of AI (LLM / Transformer)
kind: software engineering paper (engineering structure; a load-bearing argument, no physics claim)
license: GNU GPL — directly, with the PtolemyDesktop / Pharos code it uses. Independent of Ainulindale and the hyperindexer / box-kite work.
one_line: A context-prompt LLM has amnesia (no memory past the window), aphasia (loses its held intention mid-generation), aphantasia (no carried working state). RAG gives records without memory. The fix: a short-term thought buffer (Mind's Eye) on BOTH sides of the working|durable boundary, joined to a durable store (Paper's Hands) by an Operator Stitch Board of named auditable replaceable handoffs.
thesis: You cannot consolidate what you have not held, and you cannot use what you have only pasted. Consolidation IS rehearsal; retrieval IS reconstruction into a held form. Both directions pass through the short-term buffer.

cognitive_model_established.element: working memory: visuospatial sketchpad + phonological loop + central executive
short-term store -> long-term store via rehearsal (multi-store)
levels of processing - deeper processing retained better
memory consolidation - labile trace stabilises; interference blocks it
amnesia - LTM impaired, working memory intact (H.M.)

components.name: Mind's Eye - held working buffer + rehearse loop (no output, no side effects, bounded, cannot overflow); imagery channel optional
components.status: to build over a stock LLM API

components.name: Paper's Hands - append-only ordered durable store; the record of where it came from
components.status: to build; a plain append log suffices for the reference impl

components.name: Operator Stitch Board - the handoff harness; named, auditable, individually replaceable stitches; routes and stores nothing
components.status: bus ships; handoff set to wire

components.name: the stitch-set: stage / rehearse / archive / recall, each with its reason; scope dry / wet / production
the consolidation gate - archive only past a rehearsal/elaboration threshold
graceful degradation - runs with the imagery channel weak or absent

stage.reason: bring a fragment of the current situation into the working buffer to be worked on

rehearse.reason: raise salience; elaborate; THIS is the consolidation mechanism, not a separate step

archive.reason: past the gate, commit the REHEARSED form (a transform, not a copy) to the durable store

recall.reason: re-instantiate a durable item as a held malleable representation - reconstruction, not paste

candidates_open: evict (buffer full: archive under pressure or drop)
reconsolidate (recalled item edited + re-archived - new entry; original stays)

scopes.dry: memory not consulted, no commit - whiteboard
scopes.wet: memory readable, no commit - staging env
scopes.production: memory readable, commit - live; the thought becomes part of the record

desk_rejection_gate.reject: the deficits are real and measured
desk_rejection_gate.test: on a stock context-prompt model: amnesia (fact in session A absent in B), aphasia (generation drifts off stated intention past length L), aphantasia (identical situations re-derived from scratch). Numbers.

desk_rejection_gate.reject: the fix is measured vs the naive baseline
desk_rejection_gate.test: vs RAG on the same corpus/tasks: recall fidelity, argument coherence over length, consolidation quality (answer 'how did we get here?' from the store, not quote it)

desk_rejection_gate.reject: the Stitch Board adds no hidden state
desk_rejection_gate.test: each handoff is a pure function of its inputs and the two component states; serialise both, run a handoff, result depends only on what was serialised
run the full pipeline with the Mind's Eye imagery channel disabled - still stages, rehearses propositionally, archives, recalls; degraded not broken; report the delta
fixed model + seed + corpus -> identical durable store (hash) on two machines

vs RAG, long-context, fine-tuning: state where each wins (long context: within-session verbatim recall; fine-tuning: stable skills; this: cross-session narratable memory + coherence under a held intention)
run.sh from a clean checkout: pinned deps, a model endpoint, a corpus, G1/G2 numbers out

desk_rejection_gate.reject: the model is cited not claimed
desk_rejection_gate.test: every cognitive-science element traces to the provenance table; the contribution is M2-M7 only

engine.bus: Pharos/PtolBus.py (PtolemyDesktop, GPL) - pub/sub priority bus, thread-pool ownership, shared context channel
engine.components: a reference Mind's Eye + Paper's Hands over a stock LLM API (model is a black box, components sit outside it)
engine.stitches: four handoff implementations, each with its stated reason, each swappable

independence: Requires none of Ainulindale, the hyperindexer, the box kite, sedenions, Riemann zeros, or Noether. A software engineering paper. PtolemyDesktop is where the two components become visible manipulable objects - next step.
